title: BAN-PL: a Polish Dataset of Banned Harmful and Offensive Content from Wykop.pl web service

bias_targets.methodology: Comparison of the data collection method (comprehensive moderation logs) against keyword-based or hashtag-based approaches to determine if the dataset is restricted to specific topics.
Statistical analysis of the count of unique users contributing to the harmful content to assess whether the data is dominated by a small number of individuals.
Evaluation of inter-annotator agreement using Fleiss' and Randolph's kappa scores and analysis of the platform's majority voting moderation scheme.
Qualitative assessment of the dataset's dependency on the specific internal policies and professional moderators of the source platform (Wykop.pl).
